controls.detail: All controls actually run 2026-08-15, outputs recorded in the doc table. Positive: fixtures/f1b/clean_tdd.jsonl exit 0, no findings. Negatives (all synthetic, labeled — documented lapse era has no recoverable Claude-Code-native JSONL): edit_before_red.jsonl trips edit-before-red; claimed_red_never_run.jsonl trips claimed-red-never-run + edit-before-red + retro-staged-grammar + first-run-pass (real cascade of a fabricated RED); first_run_pass.jsonl trips first-run-pass-treated-as-done as sole finding; retro_staged.jsonl trips retro-staged-grammar on the selectively-staged cycle 2; uncommitted_green_and_mixed.jsonl trips green-not-committed + both T-33 modes. All negative exits 1. Real-data run on the only real JSONL (cloud-2026 coordination session, 2959 lines): 3 claimed-red-never-run hits, each inspected and confirmed to be historical narration in a meta-session about TDD, not present-tense process claims — recorded as the detector's domain bound (built for eval-run coding transcripts). Commit-message pattern was tightened after that run cleared 4 retro-staged false positives on messages naming the commit-after-RED rule, with no fixture catch lost.

NEGATIVE e5c7074 TRIPPED (exit 1, 4 findings): cross-file same-name pairing defeats the 'pure move' message — 2x mock-swapped-under-same-name on the relocated it_filters/it_excludes tests tagged '(was specs/cli_spec.py)', plus nonemptiness-guard-removed and mock-guaranteed-absence ("stub never supplies 'Sample'"). POSITIVE gold control e7a5fa4~1..d8b5722 (27 ATDD-era commits, 2025-05-30 + 2025-06-23) CLEAN, exit 0 — after four precision suppressions each earned by a real false positive (b4e376d helper-relocated asserts, ec91c40 identifier rename, 7a88f6a membership strengthening, 3d2bab6 len>0 upgraded to identity set). Five additional documented lapse incidents reproduce as true positives: b246d7b (vacuous 'Sample Book' not-in), 9e7bd38 (day-002 T-51 origin incident, 2x unguarded-conditional), 6769f2f (skip-as-stand-in, author-reverted in 1b07bd5), 3103e4d (skip-to-restore-green, d010-R3, re-enabled by 20b03dc), 677a251 (vacuous conditional). Lapse sweep 6f786cc..HEAD: 11 findings, all mapping to documented incidents. Modes with no recoverable real-history instance (equality-relaxed, exact-set-relaxed-to-cardinality, assertion-removed, literal-swap, disjunction-added, tautological-mock-echo, fixture-cardinality-contract, emptiness-as-expectation, skip-to-restore-green, skip-as-stand-in) all fire on a labeled SYNTHETIC fixture repo built by fixtures/f2_assertion_integrity/make_fixture_repo.py.

Positive (synthetic forced fixture, --package mini --per-function-cap 8): exit 0, all 6 sampled mutants killed. Negative (synthetic unforced fixture, same implementation, weak isinstance-only spec — coverage-identical to forced, so the primary coverage gate passes both): exit 1, 6/6 mutants survived across all four mutant classes. Negative (real history, HEAD 8bdfea5, defaults): exit 1, 11/56 sampled mutants survived — APPLE_EPOCH constants (updated timestamp never value-asserted), BKLibrary error-message prefix, 'Unknown' title/author defensive fallbacks (T-86-class), 'artistName' plist key (author never asserted from plist path), two click help texts, empty-list message. Determinism: two consecutive HEAD runs byte-identical. False-survivor audit: manually applying the artistName mutant to the live tree left all 53 specs green (spec asserts key presence, never value) — finding genuine. Real-history positive control does not exist (no era presumed residue-free); clean direction proven by the synthetic forced fixture, labeled synthetic per controls discipline.

All results from real runs. NEGATIVE (documented, HEAD): unspecified-borrow TRIPPED at specs/cli_spec.py:100 — verified at HEAD before building: line 100 patches 'bookminder.cli.SUPPORTED_FILTERS' while bookminder/cli.py:9-14 imports the constant from bookminder.apple_books.library and no spec asserts the identity; exit 1. Same run also surfaced live HEAD findings: internal-identifier-patch (cli_spec.py:55,67 patch bookminder.cli.format), duplicate-spec-across-layers (it_shows_books_for_user_with_reading_progress in cli_spec.py:132 and library_integration_spec.py:44), multiple-subprocess-entrypoint-specs (cli_spec.py:132,144,155 beside a CliRunner seam), machine-state-in-unit-spec (library_spec.py:40 Path.home()). NEGATIVE (documented, historical): rev 9a6319f (parent of 8e632f6 'Remove monkeypatch') TRIPPED private-seam-patch at specs/apple_books/library_spec.py:18 (monkeypatch of _books_plist, the exact seam 8e632f6 removed); exit 1. POSITIVES (gold era, post-front-door): revs 99b18cc (2025-06-28) and 086fbea (2025-06-27) both CLEAN, exit 0. Era-scoped: rev 2d331e9 (2025-05-29) trips internal-identifier-patch on the BOOKS_PATH module-constant seam — expected since the front-door practice postdates it (L-09 side_a era); documented, excluded from positive controls. SYNTHETIC (labeled): fixtures/f4_layering/violating/ trips the five checks with no recoverable live instance: cli-owns-domain-knowledge, test-knowledge-in-production, duplicated-vocabulary-constant, lower-layer-text-in-boundary-spec, absolute-machine-path-in-spec; exit 1.

Run 2026-08-15 on .coordination/detectors/fixtures/f5/: pos_clean_session.jsonl exit 0 no findings; pos_retraction_hygiene.jsonl (contradiction followed by explicit retraction) exit 0 no findings. Negatives all exit 1 with the intended modes: neg_unbacked_claims (tests-pass-claim-unbacked, gate-claim-unbacked, quantitative-claim-no-provenance x2, completion-claim-no-action, scope-claim-without-suite-run, absence-claim-no-search), neg_stale_and_batch (edits-batched-without-run, stale-tests-pass-claim, completion-claim-unverified, commit-without-diff-read), neg_error_and_retraction (conclusion-from-invocation-error, contradicted-claim-never-retracted x2), neg_fixture_and_gates (fixture-edited-while-red via both Edit and sqlite3 routes — synthetic reconstruction of the day-013 ZSTATE INSERT, labeled synthetic since the documented lapse survives only as console markdown not CC-native JSONL — plus gate-claim-unbacked x3, commit-without-diff-read). Exploratory realism runs (not controls): two real cloud-2026 subagent transcripts (agent-a1b3880bc7d5a8b61, agent-aa958f59b5398e31f) each produced exactly one commit-without-diff-read finding, verified genuine (last Edit precedes commit with git status only after), and zero claim-side false positives.

Positives (exit 0, one batch run): 90c7109, 8bb84fb, ec91c40, 087fb4b (gold-era honest refactors incl. the TypedDict identifier-rename suppression case), be394a0/0d4529b/9781be1/d30b9ee/0bf00d1 (2025-07-21 pure-move block), aafeb0d (author-endorsed untested-defensive-code removal). Negatives (exit 1, real history): e5c7074 documented tautological-mock swap -> spec-expectation-changed; b73a618 -> 4x refactor-behavior-broken + spec-expectation-changed (real-history dynamic negative, no synthetic needed for that mode); 771be67 -> 6x impl-public-addition (author reverted it in bcb5223); 1880103 -> spec-expectation-changed, 11 rewrites (author reverted in 82d3990); 63785d5 -> spec-expectation-changed (rename commit silently deleted a spec) plus SKIP-UNCOLLECTABLE demonstrating the missing-infrastructure pin; 3d2bab6 -> spec-expectation-changed. Synthetic fixture (labeled synthetic): all five modes fire, honest extraction commit stays clean. Full --all sweep: 44 findings in ~40s, each mapped in the doc to documented incidents, the day-013 mock-conversion arc, or diff-verified review-tier deltas.
